p: Shittim two men to spy secretly: Which was in the plain of Moab near Jordan.
Bring forth the men that are: Though the wicked see the hand of God on them, they do not repent, but seek how they may by their power and policy resist his working.
roof of the house: Meaning, on the house: for then their houses were flat above, so that they might do their business on it.
terror is fallen upon us: For so God promised, De 28:7, Jos 5:1.
the LORD your God: In this the great mercy of God appears, that in this common destruction he would draw a most miserable sinner to repent, and confess his Name.
Our life for yours: We warrant you on pain of our lives.
mountain: which was near to the city.
We will be blameless of this: We will be released from our oath if you perform this condition that follows for so shall you and yours be delivered.
his blood shall be upon his: He shall be guilty of his own death.
business: So that others should think to escape by the same means.
